question: In the BatPaC comparison, how much lower are the total pack cost and the material cost with Co-free cathodes than with NCA cathodes?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text, strength FROM atoms WHERE lower(text) LIKE '%batpac%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%pack cost%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%material cost%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%$/kwh%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%per kwh%' ORDER BY page, id
SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE page=3 OR (page=2 AND line_no>=40) ORDER BY page, line_no

WITH a AS (SELECT text FROM lines WHERE id='p3.L18'), b AS (SELECT text FROM lines WHERE id='p3.L19'), c AS (SELECT text FROM lines WHERE id='p3.L20')
SELECT CAST(replace(regexp_extract(b.text, '\$([0-9 ]+) total', 1),' ','') AS INT) - CAST(regexp_extract(a.text, '\$([0-9]+) total', 1) AS INT) AS total_pack_diff,
CAST(regexp_extract(c.text, '\$([0-9]+) material', 1) AS INT) - CAST(regexp_extract(a.text, '\$([0-9]+) material', 1) AS INT) AS material_diff
FROM a, b, c
